what: Upstash's MCP server that pulls up-to-date library docs into your coding agent's prompt, so it stops writing last year's API against a customer's newer stack.

Google's open-source tool that turns natural-language instructions into Android automation, with MCP so Claude Code and other agents can drive a real phone for mobile demos and QA without Appium scripts.
DeusData's MCP server that links code, docs, config and infrastructure into a local knowledge graph, so you can learn a customer's unfamiliar codebase on day one. No hosted service or API key.
VectifyAI's vectorless, reasoning-based RAG for long documents like contracts, filings and manuals, without a vector database.
Nous Research's self-improving agent that creates skills from experience, works with any model provider and runs on a $5 VPS.
